parsed.why: Enforced bathroom-trespass regime with a documented arrest, police ID checks at restrooms, and a birth-certificate marker ban. Top 'Do Not Travel' tier, and custody and facility rules are universal exposures. No trans-specific violence denominator, so violence is unassessed.

Sanctuary law, gender-identity nondiscrimination and hate-crime coverage, and X markers on some IDs. Traveller exposure is reduced by the national passport and entry regime. Two unsolved shootings of Black trans women in one city lack a denominator and lower the score.

Birth-certificate bathroom rule for public schools, sports bans, and a surgery requirement that leaves most trans people with mismatched ID. No hate-crime coverage and no statewide nondiscrimination. College bathroom ban is unverified, and no visitor-facing enforcement is documented.

Statewide gender-identity nondiscrimination and hate-crime coverage, facilities access protected, no-surgery ID changes, and a highest-court ruling for care. Custody relief operates by consent decree. National passport and entry rules still apply, and ballot-measure risk is pending.

'Most Protective' tier with a 2022 healthcare shield law, broad gender-identity discrimination ban, hate-crime coverage, and custody by gender identity. No-surgery marker change and X options. National passport and entry exposure still applies.
